entities.summary: Werner Stumm was a Swiss chemist. After earning his doctorate in inorganic chemistry at the University of Zürich in 1952, he moved to the U.S., where he was active as a professor at Harvard University until 1969. From 1970 until 1992, he was head of the Swiss Federal Water Resources Centre EAWAG.
